bullets.text: Russia reported that at least seven people were killed in the largest Ukrainian attack of 2026, while Moscow also launched deadly strikes against Ukraine overnight.
The death toll from a boat accident in Zimbabwe has risen to 68, with 22 more bodies recovered after a ferry capsized on Lake Kariba, including eighteen children.
An American missionary, Kevin Rideout, who was kidnapped in Niger in October, has been freed after nine months and is reportedly in good health.

The hospital and emergency department in Batemans Bay, a popular holiday destination on the NSW South Coast, is scheduled to close next year, raising concerns amid a growing population and tourist influx.
Victorian labour hire companies that provide substandard housing for migrant workers could lose their licences under new regulations designed to protect vulnerable individuals.
Australian health experts are concerned that US vaccine scepticism is influencing public opinion, as a 3% decrease in one-year-olds fully immunised against hepatitis B has been recorded.

Most US voters report being worse off under the current administration, with Democrats leading Republicans on economic sentiment just months before midterm elections, according to a Financial Times poll.

The Federal Reserve's internal debate on interest rates is under scrutiny as minutes from the July meeting reveal an unusually visible split among policymakers regarding a quarter-point rate increase.
Japan's recent yen purchases indicate a significant shift as the world's largest carry trader begins to unwind its positions, impacting global financial markets.
